test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: In a group of 15 people, 7 read Hindi, 8 read English and 3 read none of these language. How many people read Hindi and English both ?
solution:
In a group of 15 people, 7 read Hindi, 8 read English and 3 read none of these languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/156bc07e32cc9004d19fc8a3e183b9749e86f2aaad6cb7447b91b91d608b0ac5.png] 

Number of people who speak at least one language = (15 – 3) = 12

Number of people who can speak both Hindi and English = (7 + 8) – 12

= 15 – 12

= 3

Hence, the correct answer is **"3".**
